passages.note: Aye on Assembly concurrence in Senate amendments, the final Assembly vote on the chaptered text; 16 of 77 voting No, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Chaptered text the concurrence vote adopted; its operative sections forbid disclosure-requiring rules and do not themselves mandate secrecy, so they exclude rung 1 and rungs 3-5.

rows.reasoning: Gipson voted Aye (61-16) on final Assembly concurrence in AB 1955 (2023-2024), whose operative Section 220.5 says schools "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without consent. That matches the rung "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents"; the bill only bars disclosure mandates and does not "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents", so the rung above is excluded.
